name: India

seo.title: India Travel Guide: Delhi, Agra, Jaipur, Mumbai & Goa
seo.description: Plan your India trip with detailed guides to Delhi, Agra, Jaipur, Mumbai and Goa: top places to visit, UNESCO sites, food, best time to visit and itineraries.
seo.h1: India Travel Guide: Five Iconic Cities

heading: India Travel Guide: Five Iconic Cities
description: From Mughal monuments and royal palaces to Mumbai's sea-facing skyline and Goa's beaches, India's five most iconic destinations cover heritage, architecture, food, culture and coast in one trip.

quickFacts.Suggested trip: Delhi–Agra–Jaipur Golden Triangle plus Mumbai and Goa

citiesSection.heading: Top Cities in India
citiesSection.body: Choose a city to see its main places to visit.

cities.name: Delhi
cities.intro: Delhi is India’s capital and one of the country’s oldest continuously important urban centres.
cities.knownFor: Mughal monuments, colonial architecture, Old Delhi food
cities.bestTime: October to March (pleasant weather); April to June is very hot; July to September is monsoon

cities.name: Agra
cities.intro: Agra is a historic city on the banks of the Yamuna River in Uttar Pradesh.
cities.knownFor: Taj Mahal, Mughal forts, marble inlay craft
cities.bestTime: October to March; summers are very hot

cities.name: Jaipur
cities.intro: Jaipur is the capital of Rajasthan and is widely known as the Pink City.
cities.knownFor: Pink City, palaces, forts, jewellery and textiles
cities.bestTime: October to March; summers are very hot

cities.name: Mumbai
cities.intro: Mumbai is India’s financial, commercial, media and entertainment capital.
cities.knownFor: Colonial Gothic and Art Deco, Bollywood, street food, sea views
cities.bestTime: November to February; June to September is heavy monsoon

cities.name: Goa
cities.intro: Goa is a coastal state on India’s west coast, best presented as a region rather than a single city.
cities.bestTime: November to February; June to September is monsoon with many beach shacks closed
